folder_html:
LIVE AIR TEMPERATURE

Near-surface (2 m) air temperature from the operational HRRR analysis. Apple-style spectrum: deep blue cold through red warm, with rare extreme cold continuing into blue-violet/violet/deep-purple (continuous through freezing, no break).

2 m air temperature (degF), fixed Apple-style absolute spectrum (-40..130 F): purple extreme cold → blue → cyan → green → yellow → orange → red extreme heat. Same temperature always shows the same color. Record LOWEST 27.11 / HIGHEST+ 73.37 marked on the scale. Freezing has no color break.
